spots.name: Robert Moses SP, Massena: Hawkins Point
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 122 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L5478679.

spots.name: Barnhart Island Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
